6. ADJUSTMENTS AND SETTINGS 6-1 The Game PC Board Assy is fitted with 4 Option Switches. Option Switches Volume Control Option Switches Switch 1 is used to change between Test Mode and Game Mode. ON: Test Mode OFF: Game Mode Switch 2 is used to set the output level of the video signal. 31kHz ON: 0.7V p-p OFF: 0.7V p-p 15kHz ON: 3.0V p-p OFF: 0.7v P-P Switch 3 is used to change the monitor Sync Frequency ON: 31kHz OFF: 15kHz Note: When using a 31kHz monitor, set the RGB input of the monitor to 0.7v. If the monitor does not have a setting adjustment, refer to page 17 section 6-2-1 “Display Test’, and change the Contrast and RGB Brightness levels to adjust the brightness. Switch 4 is used to set the Video Sync Signal ON: Composite Sync OFF: Seperate Sync Page 15

If the game is switched on with either switch in the ON position the Test Mode will not be activated. The switch must be switched OFF and then ON to enter the test mode. 6-2-4 Interlace Interlace Mode: Non-Interlaced Mode: This mode provides a more detailed and smoother graphics than the non-interlaced mode. This is achieved by shifting the picture display a half line in the vertical direction every other frame scan, so doubling the vertical resolution without changing the horizontal/vertical frequency. Use this display if the interlace mode results in flicker over the entire screen display. In the non-interlaced mode, there is no shift of the display position, and the display remains constant every time. 1 Ensure that the Colour Edit Adjustment Box is showing. (Press P1 Button 3 if the Adjustment box is not displayed.) 2. Use the Joystick LEFT/RIGHT to change Interlace/Non Interlace.
